network-hacker-starter-passive.scope: Unload/reload removes and restores +1 Viral Accuracy Bonus. The retained-sight Logic Blast comparison consumes the change, input 35 → 34.

resist-contagion-starter-passive.head: e76b8be3892a0009a38036d6618737e094deff93
resist-contagion-starter-passive.scope: Native unload/reload removes and restores +1 Stun Duration Bonus and +5 Viral Accuracy Bonus.

resist-viruses-starter-passive.head: e76b8be3892a0009a38036d6618737e094deff93
resist-viruses-starter-passive.scope: Native unload/reload removes and restores +4 Contested Withdraw, +4 Viral Defense Bonus and +2 Evade Interlock. Contested Withdraw consumption stays open.

stats.source: GOB 64 supplies +1 Viral Accuracy Bonus (1147) while loaded and grants Network Hacker Upgrade (1078).
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes and totals the sourced passive, and AbilityStats.ViralAccuracy reads it for FreeCastViralContest. The retail linked coefficient is a separate source check.
stats.test: StarterHackerViralPassiveTransitionsMode verifies the +1 record, its removal and restoration, and the 35 → 34 live contest comparison. Native PR605 reproduces the same change with a held target and tactic. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/605#issuecomment-7056914061

behavior-tests.source: GOB 64 has no cast cost. Its while-loaded passive and action grant follow Archive membership.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityPassives and AbilityGrantRegistration withdraw and re-publish the passive and the associated 1078 action. The live contest consumes the active total.
behavior-tests.test: StarterHackerViralPassiveTransitionsMode covers full loadout, +1 add/remove, grant withdrawal and restoration, and three live inputs with the upgrade off and on. PR605 verifies the stock load/unload and inputs. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/605#issuecomment-7056914061

targeting.source: GOB 40 Code Freeze 1.0 selects a valid target within 20 m and requires sight. Its ordinary hostile free cast uses the existing viral contest.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler checks live selection and stored range before cast, debit or timer. AbilityTargets checks sight at landing before the contest and effect.
targeting.test: StarterHackerControlTargetMode covers the invalid/stale and clear selected outcomes. StarterHackerMovementDebuffRangeMode and native PR606 confirm a held far target is refused before cast or reuse and an in-range obstructed target reaches no contest or modifier. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/606#issuecomment-7056958796
